title: Apply for a school place
summary: Apply for a primary school place in one of the five pilot regions. Takes 20 to 25 minutes and cannot be saved part-way.

body.value: Use this service to apply for a primary school place for your child in one of the five pilot regions for the 2026/27 school year.

Before you start, you will need:

  • your child's PPS number and date of birth
  • your child's birth certificate (JPG, PDF, PNG or TIFF, maximum 10MB)
  • two proofs of address dated within the last 30 days, such as utility bills or bank statements
  • if you are applying for a Special Class place, a professional diagnosis report and NCSE confirmation letter
This application takes approximately 20 to 25 minutes to complete. You cannot save and return, so have everything ready before you begin.
Applications for the 2026/27 school year open 1 October and close 22 October 2026. Applications submitted after this date will not be accepted.

• round 1 offers will be issued on 12 November 2026
  • round 2 offers will be issued on 4 December 2026

You will receive a message when a decision is available. Open it in your messages to read the decision securely.
